name: agent-fe-threejs
description: Optional 3D add-on for Next.js sites that use three.js or React Three Fiber; install it next to agent-fe-nextjs or agent-fe-nextjs-static. No hooks. Commands: setup and sync install and verify rules for gating the scene, a still fallback, reduced motion, disposing GPU resources and asset budgets, plus a guide to adding third-party 3D skills by reference (nothing is vendored).
